name: Payette River (Banks)
blurb: Idaho's closest commercial whitewater to Boise. Banks to Horseshoe Bend — waves, holes, and a highway shuttle.

sections.notes: BLM’s P02 guide measures this run from Banks River Access to Beehive Bend at 7.3 miles and includes Class III+ rapids. Arrange a road shuttle along Highway 55; confirm the current river-access fee and conditions.

putIn.name: Banks
putIn.sourceLocation: PDF page 15, P02, Banks River Access

distanceEvidence.note: Replaces an unsupported five-mile listing with the BLM guide distance.

sections.routeReview: Approximate river-course overview with generalized bends and gravel bars. The dotted line does not identify safe rapid lines, current obstructions, exact landings or bank access.

notices.title: Check seasonal access and parking fees
notices.text: Banks and Danskin list a late-May through late-September season, subject to snow. Confirm current access before setting a shuttle. BLM lists $5/day parking or the $30 Boise National Forest Annual Day Use Pass at Beehive Bend and Confluence. Follow the signs at the facility.
notices.sourceName: BLM / Boise National Forest — Payette boating facilities

sections.notes: Mixmaster and the rest of the Lower Main. Rafts and kayaks. Scout or go with a guide if it's new water.
sections.accessReview: The legacy takeout label does not establish whether it means the Parnell Recreation Site or the separate Horseshoe Dam Bridge access in BLM guide P03. Confirm the intended landing and route before planning.
